DataflowUpgradeReadiness.description: The upgrade readiness assessment for a Gen1 dataflow.

id.description: The identifier of the assessed Gen1 dataflow.

displayName.description: The display name of the Gen1 dataflow.

status.description: The overall readiness verdict for the dataflow. The value is the highest severity among the reasons in this order: `UpgradeUnavailable`, `NeedsAttention`, and `ReadyToMigrate`. `Unknown` is not an aggregation outcome and means the readiness assessment could not be completed.

reasons.description: The reasons behind the readiness verdict. This property is omitted when the status is `ReadyToMigrate` and is always present when the status is `Unknown`.

DataflowUpgradeReadinessReason.description: A reason contributing to a Gen1 dataflow upgrade readiness verdict.

status.description: The readiness severity contributed by this reason.

code.description: The stable code identifying the readiness reason.

message.description: The human-readable message accompanying the reason code.

DataflowUpgradeReadinessStatus.description: The Gen1 dataflow upgrade readiness status. Additional DataflowUpgradeReadinessStatus types may be added over time.

values.description: The readiness assessment could not be completed and should be reported for investigation.
The upgrade is expected to succeed without changes before or after the upgrade.
The upgrade is expected to succeed, but follow-up changes may be needed or the upgrade may adjust the dataflow automatically.
The upgrade is expected to fail until the reported reasons are resolved.

DataflowUpgradeReasonCode.description: The reason for a Gen1 dataflow upgrade readiness result. Additional DataflowUpgradeReasonCode types may be added over time.

values.description: The dataflow might be accessed through DirectQuery.
The dataflow uses bring-your-own-lake storage.
The dataflow uses incremental refresh.
The dataflow has linked entities.
The dataflow is referenced by linked entities in other dataflows.
The readiness assessment was throttled and may succeed when retried later.
The display name contains characters that are unsupported by Dataflow Gen2 and are sanitized during the upgrade.
The sanitized display name is already in use and is prefixed during the upgrade.
The dataflow has more load-enabled queries than Dataflow Gen2 supports.
One or more data source connections could not be resolved and must be recreated or rebound before the upgrade.
The readiness assessment could not run and should be reported for investigation.

dataflows.description: The Gen1 dataflows to upgrade in the specified workspace.

id.description: The identifier of the Gen1 dataflow to upgrade. The dataflow must belong to the specified workspace.

summary.description: The roll-up counts for the upgrade batch.

migrations.description: The migration result for each requested dataflow.

DataflowUpgradeSummary.description: The roll-up counts for a Gen1 dataflow upgrade batch.

totalCount.description: The total number of dataflows in the request.

succeededCount.description: The number of dataflows that were upgraded successfully.

failedCount.description: The number of dataflows that failed to upgrade.

DataflowMigration.description: The migration result for a Gen1 dataflow.

dataflowId.description: The identifier of the dataflow, which is preserved by a successful in-place upgrade.

dataflowName.description: The source Gen1 dataflow display name.

targetDataflowName.description: The resulting Dataflow Gen2 display name, which may differ from the source display name.

workspaceId.description: The identifier of the workspace containing the dataflow.

workspaceName.description: The display name of the workspace containing the dataflow.

assessmentStatus.description: The readiness verdict evaluated for the dataflow during the upgrade. This property does not report `UpgradeUnavailable`; a readiness result that predicts failure is reported as `NeedsAttention` because the migration status and migration error describe the actual outcome.

requiredActions.description: The changes required before the dataflow can be upgraded. This property is omitted when no changes are required.

migrationStatus.description: The migration outcome for the dataflow.

migrationEndDateTime.description: The time when the dataflow migration reached a terminal state. This property is omitted when the time is not available. When present, the value is in UTC, using the YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ format.

migrationError.description: The failure detail for the dataflow migration. This property is present only when the migration status is `Failed`, and `isRetriable` is always included. The `requestId` contains the upgrade operation ID. The error code is one of `InsufficientPrivileges`, `DataflowNotFound`, `DataflowBusy`, `DataflowRequiresChanges`, `CapacityOrLicenseNotSupported`, or `UpgradeFailed`.

isRetriable.description: Indicates whether the dataflow migration can be retried.

DataflowUpgradeRequiredAction.description: A change required before a Gen1 dataflow can be upgraded.

status.description: The readiness severity contributed by this required action.

code.description: The stable reason code identifying the required change.

message.description: The human-readable description of the required change.

DataflowMigrationStatus.description: The outcome of a Gen1 dataflow migration. Additional DataflowMigrationStatus types may be added over time.

values.description: The migration outcome was not populated and indicates a service defect if returned.
